'''Pok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuzzem]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was a friend of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] while the young [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] lived on Tatooine.
